text: In cubical type theory (CCHM), the interval 𝕀 has endpoints:
choices: 0 and 1, with 𝕀 a type in the universe
i0 and i1, with 𝕀 a primitive not in the universe
left and right, as named constructors
explanation: In CCHM, 𝕀 has endpoints i0 and i1. It is primitive — not a type in the universe — so you cannot quantify over it with Π without using the Path type abstraction.
